build_confidence_head_module: build a ConfidenceHead Haiku module to predict distance errors and confidence scores for protein structure predictions
create_confidence_head_config: create a ConfidenceHead.Config with pairformer layers, pLDDT bins, and distogram features for AlphaFold 3
run_confidence_head_call: run the ConfidenceHead call method to compute pLDDT, pAE, and pDE from atom positions and embeddings
review_embed_features_method: review the _embed_features method that projects target features and distogram features into pair activations
summarize_tmscore_adjusted_pae: summarize the _get_tmscore_adjusted_pae method that computes global and interface TM-score adjusted predicted aligned error
